title: Similarity Is Not Validity: Defending LLM Semantic Caches Against Poisoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.35908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic caches reduce LLM serving costs by reusing previously generated answers for semantically similar queries. However, retrieval is based solely on embedding similarity between the incoming query and cached queries. This design enables cache poisoning: an attacker can cache a malicious response under a query with high cosine similarity to benign requests. The vulnerability stems from a gap between retrieval similarity and answer validity. From an information-bottleneck perspective, query embeddings can lose information needed to distinguish valid from invalid cache hits, which limits any matching algorithm that uses only these embeddings. We propose a novel defense that recovers this necessary information from the raw text of the cache key. translated_title: 相似性不等于有效性：防御大语言模型语义缓存的投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 语义缓存通过复用先前为语义相似查询生成的答案，来降低大语言模型的服务成本。然而，其检索仅基于传入查询与缓存查询之间的嵌入相似度。这种设计使缓存投毒成为可能：攻击者可以在一个与良性请求具有高余弦相似度的查询下缓存恶意响应。该漏洞源于检索相似度与答案有效性之间的差距。从信息瓶颈的视角来看，查询嵌入可能丢失区分有效与无效缓存命中所需的信息，这限制了任何仅使用这些嵌入的匹配算法。我们提出了一种新颖的防御方法，从缓存键的原始文本中恢复这一必要信息。在各类投毒攻击中，对抗性查询共享一种“改写-残差”结构：它们将目标查询的改写与残差内容相配对。改写部分维持了高相似度，而……
tldr: 该论文揭示了LLM语义缓存因仅依赖嵌入相似度进行检索而存在的投毒漏洞，并提出一种从缓存键原始文本中恢复关键信息的新防御方法，以区分有效与无效的缓存命中。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a cache poisoning vulnerability in LLM semantic caches caused by retrieval relying solely on embedding similarity, and proposes a novel defense that recovers essential information from the raw text of cache keys to distinguish valid from invalid cache hits.
